issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip but does not exit, then later invokes unzip anyway
issues.detail: Under set -euo pipefail the script prints 'unzip is not installed' and proceeds to call unzip, dying with a cryptic error mid-run instead of failing fast at the precondition check. Either exit non-zero on the missing tool or remove the guard entirely.

issues.description: Usage block prints help but does not exit on bad argv, falling through to realpath of unset $1
issues.detail: When argc is out of [1,2] the script cats usage and continues into realpath $1. With set -u this aborts opaquely instead of returning a clean usage failure. Add 'exit 1' after the heredoc so precondition violations terminate cleanly.

issues.description: README ASR config link points to a path that does not exist
issues.detail: README references ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml but the file lives at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml (no train/ subdir). The link 404s on GitHub. Fix the path so the documentation matches the artifact.

issues.description: Unquoted realpath arguments under set -u break on whitespace or empty values
issues.detail: realpath $1 and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted. Paths with spaces split into multiple words and any empty positional crashes under set -u. Quote them: realpath "$1" and realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}" to match the rest of the script's discipline.

issues.description: Transcript normalization sed chain is opaque, brittle, and has no stated target alphabet
issues.detail: The pipeline strips a hand-picked set of full-width punctuation and characters via successive sed calls with no documentation of which characters are legal, no invariant tying the filter to the tokenizer's alphabet, and no argument the set is complete. Express normalization as a documented table or single mapping file rather than inline plumbing.

issues.description: run.sh sets use_lm=false but README documents LM-decoded results, so the recipe cannot reproduce its published numbers
issues.detail: run.sh disables the LM (use_lm=false) while still passing --lm_config and --lm_train_text, yet README.md advertises decode_asr_branchformer_lm rows as reproducible. A user running run.sh as-is cannot reproduce the LM results. Either default use_lm=true or document the required override.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a standard ESPnet recipe contribution where the YAML/symlink boilerplate is fine but the two real shell scripts are unreasoned. download_and_untar.sh advertises preconditions (unzip installed, argc in [1,2]) it does not enforce, then crashes opaquely downstream; unquoted realpath calls compound the fragility under set -euo pipefail. local/data.sh's text-normalization pipeline is folkloric — an opaque sed chain with no documented target alphabet — and the README links to a config path that does not exist. The recipe also disables the LM in run.sh while documenting LM-decoded results, breaking reproducibility of its own published table. Fixes are small and local; ship-blocking are the silent-failure bugs in download_and_untar.sh and the broken README link.
